extracted.intended_audience: researchers/authors, reviewers and librarians interested in Royal Society journals
extracted.subtask_description: Information and publisher-level standards describing the scope, focus and publication attributes of individual Royal Society journals, open-access policy, and resources for authors, reviewers and librarians. Useful for authors deciding where and how to submit work to Royal Society titles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Philosophical Transactions A — themed influential issues (physical, mathematical, engineering)
rubrics_metrics.description: Influential themed journal issues across the physical, mathematical and engineering sciences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Philosophical Transactions B — themed influential issues (life sciences)
rubrics_metrics.description: Influential themed journal issues across the life sciences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interface Focus — themed cross-disciplinary issues
rubrics_metrics.description: Themed issues covering cross-disciplinary research at the interface between the physical, life and social sciences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proceedings A — high‑quality physical sciences research and reviews
rubrics_metrics.description: The Royal Society’s physical sciences research journal, publishing high-quality research and review articles from all disciplines in the physical sciences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proceedings B — fast dissemination of high‑quality biological research
rubrics_metrics.description: The Royal Society's flagship biological research journal, dedicated to the fast publication and worldwide dissemination of high-quality research.

rubrics_metrics.name: Interface — cross-disciplinary research at physical/life interface
rubrics_metrics.description: Cross-disciplinary research at the interface between the physical and life sciences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biology Letters — rapid publication of short high‑quality biological research
rubrics_metrics.description: A Royal Society journal focused on the rapid publication of short high quality research articles, reviews and opinion pieces across the biological sciences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Open Biology — fast open access for high‑impact molecular/cellular biology
rubrics_metrics.description: A fast, open access Royal Society journal publishing high impact biology at the molecular and cellular level.

rubrics_metrics.name: Royal Society Open Science — fast open journal across all science/engineering/math
rubrics_metrics.description: A fast, open journal publishing high-quality research across all of science, engineering and mathematics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notes and Records — history of science scholarship
rubrics_metrics.description: The Royal Society journal of the history of science.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biographical Memoirs — commemorative scientific memoirs
rubrics_metrics.description: A unique compilation of memoirs celebrating the lives and scientific achievements of Fellows of the Royal Society.

rubrics_metrics.name: Open access policy — move to 100% open access by 2026
rubrics_metrics.description: Royal Society Publishing achieves the ambitious goal of becoming 100% open access by 2026.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is a publisher-level policy commitment affecting access and publication model for all journals; relevant to authors deciding on open access publishing and to institutions negotiating agreements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Author resources and benefits
rubrics_metrics.description: Publish your research with the world's longest-running scientific publisher alongside Isaac Newton, Charles Darwin and Rosalind Franklin. View benefits for authors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The site points authors to benefits and resources (including an ECR resource hub) that provide foundational knowledge of the publishing process and help early career researchers prepare submissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Librarian offerings and institutional agreements
rubrics_metrics.description: We offer over 360 years of research across the whole of science, Transformative Agreements, Subscribe to Open, Open Access Memberships, subscriptions and perpetual access to suit all institutions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guides the expectations and options institutions have for access and transformative/read-&-publish deals with the publisher.

rubrics_metrics.name: Searchable journal content and metadata
rubrics_metrics.description: Search our journals by keyword, subject, author name, publication date and other parameters.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates available metadata and search parameters for locating relevant articles; relevant to discovery and literature-search standards rather than manuscript evaluation.
